title: codex-review findings
description: What the reviewing model returns. Strict structured-output shape: every property required, no extras, null for absent values. The script adds kind, model, codex_version, subject_sha, base, started, finished and exit_code around it; it never writes a resolution.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what was attacked and the overall verdict.

id.description: Unique within the report, for example F1.

where.description: file:line, or plan section for a plan finding.

evidence.description: file:line quotes or command output proving the finding; for a code finding, the failing test output.

repro.description: Code mode: repo-relative path of the repro test file, then the command that runs it. Null when there is none.
